# Example Output — Static Website Config and CSP

*Generated by applying the Static Website Config and CSP skill to `example-input.md`.*

---

## 1. `staticwebapp.config.json`

```json
{
  "routes": [
    { "route": "/sitemap.xml", "headers": { "Content-Type": "application/xml" } },
    { "route": "/.well-known/apple-app-site-association", "headers": { "Content-Type": "application/json" } },

    { "route": "/docs/*",        "statusCode": 404 },
    { "route": "/infra/*",       "statusCode": 404 },
    { "route": "/scripts/*",     "statusCode": 404 },
    { "route": "/.github/*",     "statusCode": 404 },
    { "route": "/OPERATIONS.md", "statusCode": 404 },

    { "route": "/reset-password.html", "redirect": "/account/reset-password", "statusCode": 302 },
    { "route": "/reset-password",      "redirect": "/account/reset-password", "statusCode": 302 },
    { "route": "/account/reset-password", "rewrite": "/account/reset-password.html",
      "headers": { "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; connect-src https://<project-ref>.supabase.co; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'" } },

    { "route": "/*.css",    "headers": { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600" } },
    { "route": "/*.js",     "headers": { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600" } },
    { "route": "/assets/*", "headers": { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=86400" } },
    { "route": "/*",        "headers": { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate" } }
  ],
  "responseOverrides": { "404": { "rewrite": "/404.html", "statusCode": 404 } },
  "globalHeaders": {
    "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
    "X-Frame-Options": "SAMEORIGIN",
    "Referrer-Policy": "same-origin",
    "Cache-Control": "public, must-revalidate, max-age=30",
    "Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only": "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:"
  },
  "mimeTypes": { ".json": "application/json", ".xml": "application/xml", ".txt": "text/plain", ".vcf": "text/vcard" }
}
```

Notes: headers moved from `/*` to `globalHeaders` (they were missing on CSS/JS/images); the `/*.md` idea was rejected — wildcards only match at route end, so `OPERATIONS.md` is an exact-match route; the reset page keeps a 302 (transient/auth) rather than 301.

## 2. CSP plan

| Step | Action |
|---|---|
| Now | `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only` with `script-src 'self'` (above); `style-src` keeps `'unsafe-inline'` — 14 `style=""` attributes remain |
| Externalise | contact page inline `<script>` → `/scripts.js`; two `onclick=""` → `addEventListener` in `/scripts.js` |
| Verify | open every page, DevTools Console shows zero CSP report violations |
| Enforce | rename header to `Content-Security-Policy`; deploy |
| Later | extract inline styles, then drop `'unsafe-inline'` from `style-src` in a second Report-Only pass |

## 3. Page change list

- **All pages** — nav markup differs on `/about` (extra CTA) and `/contact` (aria-current): edited each copy individually. Mobile `<nav class="mobile-menu">` placed *inside* `<header>`; three stale `@media (max-width: 768px) nav` rules replaced, not appended. `<script src="/scripts.js?v=4">` (was `?v=3`).
- **`/scripts.js`** — `var y = document.getElementById('year'); if (y) …`; contact form wiring null-guarded (`if (form) form.addEventListener(…)`) so it no longer throws on the other four pages.
- **`/account/reset-password.html`** — moved; `styles.css` → `/styles.css`, `assets/logo.svg` → `/assets/logo.svg`; supabase-js `<script>` kept on the jsDelivr CDN under its per-route CSP. App-side follow-up logged: update the intent-filter path and the Supabase redirect URL to `/account/reset-password` (assetlinks unchanged — domain-wide).
- **`/team/jane-citizen.vcf`** — added; served as `text/vcard`.

```

curl -sI https://www.example.com/docs/index.md | head -1              → HTTP/2 404
curl -sI https://www.example.com/reset-password.html | grep -i location → /account/reset-password (302)
curl -sI https://www.example.com/team/jane-citizen.vcf | grep -i content-type → text/vcard
curl -sI https://www.example.com/.well-known/apple-app-site-association | grep -i content-type → application/json
```

Console clean on all five pages under Report-Only; `?v=4` fetched fresh (Network tab) — the "old JavaScript" complaint was the 3600 s cache with an unchanged `?v=`.
